releases.notes:
## What's new in Entity Detective 2.7.0:

-->
- **New command**: `/ed nark <playerName>` — profiles all entity types in a 21×21 chunk area centred on another online player’s position for 100 ticks. Useful for diagnosing lag near a specific player without being in their vicinity. Tab-completes online player names. Works from console.
- **New**: `--persistent` sub-type filter — after `--persistent`, select a persistence cause to narrow results: `all` · `name-tagged` · `holding-item` · `structure-spawn` · `in-vehicle` · `leashed` · `custom`.
- **New**: `/ed chunks loaders` and `/ed chunks stasis` — filter the chunk loader view to portal loaders or ender pearl stasis chambers only.
- **Improvement**: clickable `/tp` links are now self-contained (show the caller’s name instead of `@s`).
- **Fix**: persistent mob classification corrected (`structure spawn` and `riding vehicle` now correctly identified instead of `holding item`).


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/netcrafts/Entity-Detective/compare/v2.6.1...v2.7.0

## What's new in Entity Detective 2.6.1:

-->
- **New command**: `/entitydetective hotspot` — runs a 20-tick scan across all loaded dimensions and reports the top entity-cost chunks, showing chunk coordinates (clickable `/tp`), dominant entity type, average entity count, and MSPT. Results are colour-coded green (<5 ms), yellow (5–15 ms), red (≥15 ms). Chunks below 2 ms are filtered out.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/netcrafts/Entity-Detective/compare/v2.6.0...v2.6.1

releases.notes:
## What's new in Entity Detective 2.5.4:

-->
- **New command**: `/entitydetective chunks` — detects active portal chunk loaders (shown as paired OW ↔ Nether lines) and ender pearl stasis chambers across all dimensions. Coordinates are clickable `/tp` suggestions when you are in the matching dimension (green), non-clickable otherwise (red). Unpaired entries are marked `(unconfirmed)`.
- **New flag**: `--ticking-only` for `entity locate <be_type>` — runs a short observation window and returns only block entity positions that actually ticked.
- **New flag**: `--debug` for `entity profile <be_type>` — reports per-position tick counts instead of aggregate MSPT, useful for pinpointing which specific instance of a type is active.
- **New flag**: `--world <dim>` for `entity profile <type>` — profile a single entity or block entity type scoped to one dimension without requiring a player source.
- **New alias**: `/ed` as a shorthand for `/entitydetective`.
- **Mod attribution**: modded entity and block entity types now show a `[modid]` prefix in gold in profiler output.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/netcrafts/Entity-Detective/compare/v2.5.3...v2.5.4

releases.notes:
## What's new in Entity Detective 2.4.2:

-->
- Add `--detail` flag to all `mob`, `entity`, `item`, `entity locate`, and `item locate` commands. Expands output to a chunk-grouped entity list with clickable `/tp` on chunk headers and entity lines. Persistence reason shown per entity when combined with `--persistent`. Must be the last flag.
- `--lazy-only` and `--persistent` now always return a type-count table. Add `--detail` to see individual entities.
- `--debug` on `entity locate` retired — replaced by `--detail` (now available on every command).
- `entity profile all` no longer requires `--range`. Bare `all` profiles all dimensions; add `--world <dim>` or `--range <chunks>` to scope.
- Profiler output redesigned: `count / short-name / X.XXXmspt / avg: X.XXXms`. Vanilla `minecraft:` prefix stripped from type names. Values right-aligned so decimal points line up in the MC console.
- `entity summary --range` promoted to `entity --range <chunks>` (direct flag on the `entity` command).
- **Singleplayer compatible**: the world owner can now use all commands in a singleplayer world without enabling cheats.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/netcrafts/Entity-Detective/compare/v2.4.1...v2.4.2

readmeSummary: A server-side Fabric mod for Minecraft that gives admins commands to locate, audit, diagnose, and profile entity accumulation, and detect active chunk loaders.
